The six phase columns follow the reference. Person-days measure combined work effort, not elapsed calendar days. Phase role labels identify responsibility and do not multiply the numeric estimates.

Totals add inputs, outputs, data stores, screen layouts and interface estimates, following the supplied template. This is a phase-effort estimate; its total is not a formal IFPUG function point count.
Queue Recall, Skip, Return and Expiry
PM = Project Manager. P = Programmer. SA = Systems Analyst. AP = Assistant Programmer (assumed expansion). Role groupings are retained from the reference.
Account Recovery and Patient Record Merging
Patient accounts are created by the admin. Walk-in registration creates or reuses patient records. Queue handling includes priority, calling, recall, skip, return and missed-ticket expiry.
Historical BOHC Data and Forecast Preparation
BOHC forecasts are prepared offline and read from CSV files. The project labels synthetic history used in the forecast demonstration. Dental reports support daily entry and monthly reporting.

Layout: two user-supplied FUNCTION POINT ANALYSIS PNGs. Feature scope: E-KALUSUGAN local project, reviewed 13 October 2026. All estimates are proposed, with no measured effort data supplied.
Account and patient scope: authRoutes.js, adminRoutes.js, patientRoutes.js, patientController.js. Appointment and queue scope: appointmentRoutes.js, queueRoutes.js, Queue.js.
Clinical, report and forecast scope: doctorRoutes.js, doctorController.js, DoctorAnalyticsTab.jsx, AdminReportsTab.jsx, adminAnalyticsController.js and arima.py.
Data stores: User.js, Patient.js, Doctor.js, Staff.js, Appointment.js, Queue.js and doctorController.js. SMS stores and behavior: 005_sms_notifications.sql, smsController.js and smsNotifications.js.
Method reference: IFPUG Function Point Analysis. Formal FPA measures inputs, outputs, inquiries, internal data and external interface data. https://ifpug.org/ifpug-standards/fpa
Screen scope: App.jsx, PatientDashboard.jsx, StaffDashboard.jsx, DoctorDashboard.jsx, AdminDashboard.jsx, StaffPatientProfile.jsx and their dashboard forms and tabs.
Interface scope: db.js (database), api.js (web API), sms.js (SMS gateway), adminAnalyticsController.js (CSV data), and PatientHomeTab.jsx (clinic location map).
The reference total of 187 man-days belongs to the original example. The E-KALUSUGAN total is calculated from this workbook's scope and proposed estimates.
